reasoning.fast.success_rate.note: Fast ReAct success rate. Absolute-point band; one model refusal flake (~0.08 at n=12) warns, a ≥0.10 collapse fails.

reasoning.fast.wall_ms_median.note: Fast-path chat turn latency — the number users feel. Wide band: GPU-shared wall-clock is ~±25% noisy, so this catches a latency cliff, not drift (drift → the trend history).

reasoning.think.completion_tokens_median.note: Planning-tier token cost. Tokens are much steadier than wall-clock, so a 30% jump means the tier genuinely got heavier, not noise.

reasoning.think.success_rate.note: Planning-tier success — the S6 regression class. Must not drop below the fast control by construction.

reasoning.think.wall_ms_median.note: Planning-tier wall-clock. WARN-only: the noisiest metric we have; token-cost is the sharp cost gate instead.
